sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
def comps(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); seen=[[False]*len(a[0]) for _ in a]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c0 in range(len(a[0])):
            if a[r][c0]==ch and not seen[r][c0]:
                q=deque([(r,c0)]); seen[r][c0]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    r0,c1=q.popleft(); comp.append((r0,c1))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        r2,c2=r0+dr,c1+dc
                        if 0<=r2<len(a) and 0<=c2<len(a[0]) and a[r2][c2]==ch and not seen[r2][c2]:
                            seen[r2][c2]=True; q.append((r2,c2))
                out.append((min(p[0] for p in comp),max(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp),max(p[1] for p in comp),len(comp)))
    return out
# Move wall up one step, observe c
res=action(['UP'],intent='explore')
fr=current_frame
print('after UP: level',fr.level,'step',fr.step)
print('wall rows',sorted(set(r for r in range(len(fr.ascii.splitlines())) for c in range(len(fr.ascii.splitlines()[0])) if fr.ascii.splitlines()[r][c]=='S')))
print('B', [c for c in comps(fr,'B') if c[3]<63 and c[4]>5])
print('c', comps(fr,'c'))
print('Y', comps(fr,'Y'))
print('res', {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

from collections import deque
def comps(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); seen=[[False]*len(a[0]) for _ in a]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c0 in range(len(a[0])):
            if a[r][c0]==ch and not seen[r][c0]:
                q=deque([(r,c0)]); seen[r][c0]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    r0,c1=q.popleft(); comp.append((r0,c1))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        r2,c2=r0+dr,c1+dc
                        if 0<=r2<len(a) and 0<=c2<len(a[0]) and a[r2][c2]==ch and not seen[r2][c2]:
                            seen[r2][c2]=True; q.append((r2,c2))
                out.append((min(p[0] for p in comp),max(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp),max(p[1] for p in comp),len(comp)))
    return out
